blast-chillers.title: Frysta Blast Chiller BF100h2
blast-chillers.body_html: Designed for compact commercial kitchens and bakeries, the BF100h2 delivers professional-grade chilling and freezing in a small footprint. Built from premium stainless steel, it ensures durability and easy cleaning while fitting seamlessly into tight spaces. Rapidly lowers food temperature from +90°C to +3°C in 90 minutes or to -18°C in 240 minutes, helping chefs meet HACCP standards with ease. Perfect for small restaurants, pastry labs, and catering prep zones that demand both efficiency and reliability.

blast-chillers.title: Frysta Blast Chiller BF200h2
blast-chillers.body_html: The BF200h2 brings greater capacity and versatility to busy commercial kitchens. Ideal for mid-sized restaurants, bakeries, and meal-prep services that need consistent temperature control to preserve taste, texture, and safety. A balanced solution between compact design and industrial strength—reliable, efficient, and built to scale with your business.

blast-chillers.body_html: The BF300h2 is engineered for heavy-duty use in large-scale food production. Its robust stainless-steel construction, modern control interface, and HACCP-compliant performance make it an essential choice for professional kitchens, catering facilities, and production lines that demand top-tier reliability.

vacuum-bags.title: 65 µm Embossed Vacuum Bags
vacuum-bags.body_html: Our 65-micron vacuum bags are designed for efficient, high-performance food packaging. With reduced material usage per unit, they help lower plastic consumption and optimize storage and logistics costs—without compromising on strength, clarity, or barrier properties. Ideal for packaging meat, dairy, and ready-to-eat products, these bags provide reliable protection and are compatible with all chamber vacuum sealing machines.

vacuum-bags.title: Cooking Grade Embossed Vacuum Bags
vacuum-bags.body_html: Our high-performance vacuum bags are designed for both food storage and sous vide cooking. Made from BPA-free, food-grade materials, they deliver strong sealing performance, excellent puncture resistance, and reliable long-term preservation. Built to handle high-temperature cooking environments, these bags are available in variants that can withstand boiling temperatures of up to 100°C or even 110°C, making them ideal for a wide range of sous vide and hot water cooking applications.

vacuum-rolls.title: 75 µm Embossed Vacuum Rolls
vacuum-rolls.body_html: Cut to the size needed, reducing waste and excess plastic use, these BPA-free vacuum rolls feature an exclusive straight-channel pattern that ensures strong seals and long-lasting durability. Designed for versatility, they are safe for sous vide (up to 4 hours at 100°C), microwave, and freezer use, with a temperature tolerance from -40'℃ to 100°C. High resistance to oxygen and moisture transmission helps preserve food freshness longer.
